references.text: Both verses document the numbers before and after the same catastrophe, showing the connection between the initial strength and the number of casualties.
The verse shows the temporary power of the 26,000 warriors mentioned in the source verse, before their final defeat.
The verse describes the first day of the conflict where the 700 chosen men from Gibeah (mentioned in the source verse) demonstrate their strength.
The verse confirms that almost the entire military force mentioned in the source verse was wiped out during the war.
Creates a theological contrast between Benjamin's former strength in the wilderness and their critical situation in Judges 20.
